info.name: Task Management API v1
info.description: Complete Task Management API collection for user and administrator cycles. Run User Login or Admin Login first to store the authorization token automatically.

request.description:
Create a user account.

Required JSON: name (max 255), email (unique), password, password_confirmation.
Password: minimum 8 characters with uppercase, lowercase and number.
Optional: device_name (max 100).
Role is always user and status is active.

Authenticate an active user and save the returned token automatically.

Optional: device_name (max 100).

item.name: List Notifications and Mark Page Seen

request.description:
Authentication: Bearer token required.

Optional query: per_page (integer 1-100, default 15).
Important: every notification returned on this page is marked seen=1 and receives seen_at.

Authentication: Bearer token required.

Path variable: notification_id.
No body or query parameters. Accessing it marks seen=1 and sets seen_at.

Authentication: Bearer token required.

Optional: color (null or hex format #RRGGBB, example #FF0000).
slug is generated automatically.
